messages:
morgan: Heads up — we've got an incoming pen test tentatively Wk of Aug 2. Need to finalize scope, RBAC changes, and evidence handoff. Who can own the "impact matrix" and KMS question?

rachel: I can take impact matrix. Quick ask: do we want readonly log export roles for assessors or full readroom?

kevin: Recommend readonly S3 export + presigned urls for artifacts. For live readroom we should limit to ephemeral session only.

aj: KMS question: assessors will need to validate packaged evidence that’s encrypted. We cannot give them decrypt on prod keys. Can we create a separate "pt-evidence" key with revoke/rotate plan?

sam: +1 on separate key. Prefer a KMS proxy that mints ephemeral grants scoped to the evidence bucket; rotate key after engagement. Also need to ensure CloudTrail logs show Decrypt/GenerateDataKey calls.

morgan: Sounds good. Rachel -> impact matrix. Kevin -> evidence packaging & presigned process. AJ -> KMS key lifecycle doc + revoke steps. Sam -> telemetry/CloudTrail checklist. I'll assemble one-pager for assessors.

rachel: Starting impact matrix now. High-level cols: service, data-sensitivity, required-roles, temporary-roles, evidence-location, owner. Link to sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1PT-INTAKE-EXAMPLE (please comment)

kevin: Example packaging snippet I used before:

```bash
# package artifacts, encrypt with pt-evidence key
aws s3 cp /tmp/evidence s3://pt-evidence-bucket/pt-123/ --recursive
aws kms encrypt --key-id arn:aws:kms:...:alias/pt-evidence --plaintext fileb://bundle.tar.gz --output text --query CiphertextBlob | base64 -w0 > bundle.enc
```

kevin: For presigned URLs: set expiry 24h and enable object-lock/retention for 30d.

aj: On grants: we must not give Assessors Decrypt on prod keys. Instead: create CMK alias/pt-evidence with KeyUsage ENCRYPT_DECRYPT, add a policy that allows GenerateDataKey only to our packaging service principal, and allow Decrypt only via a short-lived grant to assessor role. Post-engagement we revoke the grant and rotate.

morgan: Good. Also we need RBAC changes documented: ephemeral assessor role ARN, allowed actions (s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket, kms:Decrypt on pt-evidence when granted), and logging requirement. Can someone draft the role policy?

kevin: Draft policy (short):

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect": "Allow","Action": ["s3:GetObject","s3:ListBucket"],"Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::pt-evidence-bucket/*"},
    {"Effect": "Allow","Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],"Resource": "arn:aws:kms:...:alias/pt-evidence","Condition": {"StringEquals": {"kms:GrantId": "PLACEHOLDER"}}}
  ]
}
```

kevin: We'll fill GrantId at time of issuance.

morgan: Nice. Ops question: will this require a small infra deploy to create alias + param store entries? @devops-bot schedule?

devops-bot: @morgan I've created a draft infra ticket: INFRA-PT-7182. Willing to pair on deploy during Tuesday slot.

sam: Telemetry checklist: ensure CloudTrail retention covers the engagement + 90d, enable S3 access logs to a separate secure bucket, and export KMS API logs to SIEM (log filter for Decrypt/GenerateDataKey). Also capture VPC flow logs for readroom sessions.

rachel: For remediation tracking — propose we use the standard vuln tracker board but tag issues with pt-7182 and include a 'verified-by-assessor' checkbox. Who will triage findings during the engagement?

morgan: Security team will Triage P0/P1. Assigning initial rotation: aj for triage lead, kevin for ops fixes, rachel for artifacts/evidence.

aj: Triage playbook items: immediate mitigations (block rules), proof-of-fix artifacts, evidence uploads (link to presigned), and retest request protocol. We should add a short template for remediation PRs: include link to evidence object and a test-step that assessor can run.

kevin: For retest cadence, suggest SLAs: 72h for initial triage, 7d for remediation window for non-P0, and retest slots every Tue/Thu. Assessor availability TBD.

morgan: Can we confirm assessor windows? @security-bot do we have the assessor calendar?

security-bot: Assessor team has tentative slots: Aug 3-5 and Aug 10-12. Please finalize requests by Jul 25.

rachel: I'll lock impact matrix and ping assessors. AJ will you draft the KMS revoke/runbook and attach to sheet?

aj: On it. I'll paste the revoke steps in the sheet and add a runbook snippet here later.

morgan: Last: incident response contingency — if they trigger active exploit simulation, we'll run the tabletop and escalate to the oncall. I've filed an incident runbook pointer in the sheet. Please review.

kevin: Quick Q: do we need to open a dedicated readroom EC2 bastion or is presigned + package flow sufficient?

sam: Presigned + packaged artifacts + ephemeral grants should be sufficient for our use-case. Readroom only if they request interactive access to staging.

morgan: Great. Thanks team — action items: Rachel (impact matrix + lock), AJ (KMS runbook), Kevin (packaging & presigned automation), Sam (telemetry checklist), DevOps (infra ticket INFRA-PT-7182). We'll reconvene Mon EOD for final signoff. :thumbsup:

devops-bot: Reminder set: reconvene Mon at 16:00 PTO.
